origin: Forty usable engineering rules, twenty English and twenty Chinese; paired meanings, no synthetic padding. Exact UTF-8 text is fixed for official-counter calibration.

rules.text: Review code concisely. Put actionable findings first and include a file and line for each finding.
Do not force push. Preserve shared history and create a new commit for corrections.
Run the tests relevant to the change before reporting it complete, and state any checks that could not run.
Keep the patch focused on the requested behavior. Split unrelated cleanup into a separate change.
Return errors with the operation and affected resource so the caller can identify the failure.
Read credentials from the designated environment variables. Never include their values in logs, fixtures, or reports.
Preserve public request and response shapes unless the change explicitly requires a versioned migration.
Read an existing file before editing it. Preserve user content outside the region owned by this tool.
Validate all inputs before writing configuration. If a multi-file update fails, restore the previous bytes.
Protect shared mutable state across concurrent calls and verify that deduplication remains atomic.
Pass subprocess arguments as an argument vector. Avoid interpolating untrusted text into shell commands.
Explain unsupported behavior in the plan before installation. Do not report a fallback as full native support.
Treat model recollection as supporting evidence. Verify delivery with request records and native hook results.
Measure the full sample set with the agreed percentile method. Preserve slow samples and report event distributions.
Keep unknown configuration values distinct from known defaults. Do not reuse a previous tier when resolution fails.
Update the task list, test matrix, and append-only progress log as soon as an independently verifiable item is complete.
Test destructive Git push cases only against a temporary local bare remote, and verify its refs afterward.
Separate rule-level token estimates from whole-session provider usage. Label scenario costs with their assumptions.
Do not assume every repeated input hits a prompt cache. Record model, cache conditions, and reported cached usage.
Before handing off unfinished work, record the reproduction command, current evidence, blocker, and next action.
简洁地评审代码，先列可操作的问题，每条问题注明文件和行号。
不要强制推送。保留共享提交历史，用新的提交完成修正。
宣布修改完成前运行相关测试，并明确列出未能执行的检查。
让补丁聚焦于用户要求的行为，无关清理另行处理。
错误应包含执行的操作和受影响的资源，便于调用方定位失败。
只从指定环境变量读取凭据，不把凭据值写入日志、测试数据或报告。
保持公开请求和响应结构；确需变更时提供明确的版本迁移方案。
修改已有文件前先读取，保留本工具托管范围之外的用户内容。
写配置前验证全部输入；多文件更新失败时恢复此前的字节内容。
并发调用必须保护共享可变状态，并验证去重操作的原子性。
用参数数组启动子进程，避免把不可信文本拼接到 shell 命令。
安装前在计划中说明不支持的行为，不把回退描述为完整的原生支持。
模型复述只作辅助证据，投递结论应与请求记录和原生 hook 结果交叉核对。
按约定的百分位算法统计全部样本，保留慢样本并报告各事件分布。
未知配置值应与已知默认值区分，解析失败时不得沿用之前的档位。
每完成一个可独立验证的条目，立即更新任务清单、测试矩阵和追加式进度日志。
有破坏性的 Git 推送测试只连接临时本地 bare 远端，并核对运行后的引用。
分别列出规则级 token 估算与整段会话的服务 usage，并注明情景成本的假设。
不要假设重复输入必然命中提示词缓存，应记录模型、缓存条件和返回的缓存用量。
交接未完成工作前，记录复现命令、现有证据、阻塞原因和下一步操作。
